name: decathlon
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then npm i -g pnpm && pnpm install; elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn; elif [ -f bun.lockb ]; then npm i -g bun && bun install; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi && echo "Container ready."'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if [ -n "$GH_TOKEN" ]; then echo "$GH_TOKEN" | gh auth login --with-token 2>/dev/null && gh auth setup-git; fi'
